title: anemia hirsuta f. genuina
intro: Anemia hirsuta f. genuina, commonly known as a variety of Anemia hirsuta, is a type of fern species belonging to the family Anemiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and various types of inflammation due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Anemia hirsuta f. genuina include analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential remedy for managing pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
